description:
Get your brand's SpiderGate CAPACITY — per-provider key pressure and subscription windows.
Answers "do I need more keys?" and, just as often, "no — more keys will not help."

🔴 TWO BLOCKS, TWO DIFFERENT SCOPES — read the labels before quoting a number:
- key_pressure has traffic_scope="pool_wide". It counts every request on a key regardless of which
  tenant caused it, because a shared key serves the whole pool. It is NOT "your usage".
- subscription_windows and the flow cross-tab are brand-scoped.

The `verdict` is the point, and it can REFUSE:
  healthy · add_keys · not_quota · account_capped · over_provisioned · unmeasurable
- not_quota — errors are high but they are NOT rate limits. Buying keys will not fix it;
  suggested_keys is deliberately null. Do not recommend keys on a not_quota verdict.
- account_capped — the cap is on the ACCOUNT, so one more key is refused identically.
- limit_source tells you whether headroom is published / partial / estimated_from_429.
  An estimate is not a published ceiling; say which one you used.

subscription_windows: READ `gauge_available` EACH TIME — it is live-changing, not a constant, and
flips as the unit work lands. While it is false, `window_percent`/`weekly_percent` are present but
`null` and state is "unmeasurable" — present-and-null, NOT absent, and NOT 0%. Never render a null
as an empty gauge; `can_set_plan` says whether assigning a package is even possible for that key.
name: gate_capacity
